# Entrechat Press

> Entrechat Press is a hybrid publisher in Toronto, Canada, for first-time nonfiction authors. We help founders, executives, coaches and experts write, publish and market books built on their expertise. Authors keep 100% of their copyright. Founded by Adina Samuels.

Every project starts with a 60-minute Book Blueprint session, where we work out what the book is about, who it's for and why the author is the one to write it. Most ghostwriting and coaching projects take about 8 months to a completed manuscript, and about 6 more months to publish. We work with authors across Canada and the United States.

## Services

- [Write](https://www.entrechatpress.com/write/): ghostwriting, book coaching with our proprietary method, and manuscript editing
- [Publish](https://www.entrechatpress.com/publish/): hybrid publishing, including design, print, ebook and in-person distribution, plus bulk orders for organizations
- [Market](https://www.entrechatpress.com/market/): book launches, early reader reviews, creator outreach, bulk sales, award submissions and donation campaigns
- [Book a discovery call](https://www.entrechatpress.com/discovery-call/)
- [Contact](https://www.entrechatpress.com/contact/)
